scenes.narration: Ever notice how many casinos seem to forget one tiny invention, the clock?
scenes.note: No establishing shot. Casino + clock are on screen at frame 0.

beats.action: Bill walks in mid-stride, already inside frame; wall clock visible on the back wall
generic casino sign lights up above the doorway
Bill plants, looks up at the clock (lookRight -> pointing anticipation)
Bill points at the clock; attention lines burst
CLOCK? gag card slams in AND the clock is violently yanked off-screen by a rope
beats.sync: keyword: clock — the word and the theft land together

beats.action: Bill freezes, turns deadpan to camera, question mark pops, camera punch
beats.sync: reaction beat right after the yank

scenes.note: Very short comedic beat — two poses and a look.

manager gives an innocent smug smile; Bill turns suspicious; sweat drop

scenes.narration: Traditional casino design often kept clocks and windows scarce, removing obvious clues for how long you've been inside.
scenes.note: Cues are removed one at a time, then the room closes in.

beats.action: enclosed traditional interior: clock on wall, window, daylight outside
CLOCK pops out of existence with a puff
WINDOW pops out of existence
SUN / daylight slides away off the top
slot machines and tables slide inward from both edges, enclosing Bill
walls arrive at their tightest; Bill small and boxed in; camera punch

scenes.narration: The lights stay the same, the machines keep flashing, and the outside world basically disappears.
scenes.note: Dense, rapid beats. Bill presses the button on a loop throughout.

beats.action: row of ceiling lights: identical, unblinking, dead constant
slot machine flashes hard on a 3-frame cycle
a porthole of outside world appears and begins shrinking
the porthole shrinks to a dot and vanishes

scenes.narration: So 20 minutes can start feeling a lot like 2 hours.
scenes.note: Main comedy scene. The environment stays IDENTICAL while Bill is destroyed — that contrast is the joke.

beats.action: 20 MINUTES card; Bill sitting upright and fine
clock hands accelerate into a blur; violet time rings ripple out
2 HOURS?! card; hard swap to exhaustedSitting — messy, tired eyes, cups, receipts, empty wallet; camera shake

scenes.narration: But here's the twist. Not every modern casino follows this rule.
scenes.note: Hard interruption. The cut itself is the gag.

beats.action: still in the dark enclosed casino; Bill mid-slump, nothing has changed yet
BUT… slams in over a record-scratch; everything freezes for 2 frames
hard cut: dark enclosed casino -> bright modern casino, wipe from the right
Bill squints in the sudden daylight, shields eyes, then relaxes

scenes.narration: Some newer casinos deliberately use daylight, open spaces, and even clocks because making you comfortable can work too.
scenes.note: The visual opposite of the enclosed scene. Bright, open, calm.

beats.action: Bill steps forward into the open bright floor, still blinking at the light
ceiling opens up; the room reads tall and airy
big window + sun revealed; warm light sweeps across the floor
camera pulls back to reveal open floor, plant, comfortable chair
a clock appears ON the wall and ticks — openly, deliberately
Bill sinks into the comfy chair, content, drink in hand

scenes.narration: So casinos don't literally ban clocks.
scenes.note: Myth correction — the nuance the title deliberately omits.

beats.action: Bill staggers on holding an absurdly large wall clock (holdingHeavy)
NOT BANNED stamps across the clock face
a second character strolls past behind wearing a wristwatch; Bill double-takes
Bill glances at the passing wristwatch, then back to camera

scenes.narration: The real trick is simpler. Control what you notice, keep you immersed, and make the outside world feel very, very far away.
scenes.note: Camera pulls back the whole scene. The wallet gag runs underneath, unnoticed.

beats.action: back to the casino floor; Bill centre, calm
chips, cards, dice and sparkles start popping in around Bill
WALLET begins floating away behind Bill — he does not react
distractions swarm; Bill goes dizzy-eyed; camera pushes in
camera pulls back hard; the outside world shrinks to a tiny distant square
the swarm thickens; the wallet drifts past the far edge of frame, still unnoticed
outside world is now a dot; Bill lit only by machine glow
Bill turns (turningBack); the wallet is gone; horrified; hard cut
